user.title: Light Palettes
user.description: Slow, smooth colour-palette effects for your lights. After setup, add palettes and effects from the integration page.

data_description.starter_palettes: Sunset, Ocean, Aurora and Embers. You can edit or delete them later.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Light Palettes is already set up. Add palettes and effects from its integration page.

data_description.topic_overrides: Usually empty. OpenBeken bulbs are found automatically and their topic is taken from the device name. Add a line like light.desk_lamp=obk_desk only if a bulb's MQTT client topic differs from its short name, or to force a light to be treated as OpenBeken.
data_description.soft_fade_interval: For lights that support neither OpenBeken nor transitions, fades are made of small colour steps this far apart. Shorter is smoother but sends more commands.

error.bad_override: Every line must look like light.entity_id=topic, with no spaces in the topic.

data_description.color_count: You'll pick the colours on the next page.

colors.title: Colours for {name}
colors.description: The effect fades through these in order, then starts over from the first one. Neighbouring colours that are close in hue give the smoothest fades.

error.name_taken: There's already a palette with this name.

data_description.lights: Bulbs or light groups. Groups are expanded and every bulb gets its own loop. A light can only follow one running effect: starting another effect that uses it takes it over.
data_description.step: How long each fade takes before the next colour starts.
data_description.jitter: Each light varies every fade by up to this much, independently of the others, so the lights drift out of step. 0 keeps them in lockstep.
data_description.stagger: Start each light at a different colour of the palette instead of all on the first one.

error.name_taken: There's already an effect with this name.
